title: "Colossus" by Siam Jem is a bold, unfiltered track of addiction’s grip
htmlContent: "Colossus" by Siam Jem is a powerful, raw look at the heavy burden of addiction. "Colossus" is here to reveal harsh realities. Drawing inspiration from influential punk bands like Bikini Kill, Siam Jem delivers a cathartic and unsettling sound. The track was recorded live in North Hollywood, capturing an energetic vibe that feels alive and real, with each note resonating. The lyrics explore the painful cycle of addiction in a way that hits hard, backed by powerful vocals that express both strength and sadness. The music reflects this inner turmoil, and the intense guitar sounds create an unstoppable force that mirrors the challenges the song addresses. https://open.spotify.com/album/5WcAHvU1UNcKpdlf946Axi?si=XMR61aD3RYCySzBY4seN9w You can sense the desperation, the fight against it, and the moments of giving in. Wrapped in a bold musical experience, "Colossus" grabs your attention and won't let go. It's a blunt look at a struggle many people face. Its raw honesty offers a sense of connection, a shout into the emptiness, and a reminder to keep pushing onward. Follow on: Instagram
